label: r3c3
name: circular trunk + 2D cyclic roll head
hypothesis: The trunk and window convs use circular padding. The frame-mixed type maps then pass through a learned full-grid circular conv (T→T, kernel Y×X), so any 2D wrap-around shift of the anchor grid, combined with dihedral frames and type relabelling, can be represented. A softmax picks between the 2 flatten orders. If the observation is also rolled, the circular padding keeps the true neighbourhoods. It is refuted if train and dev are both 0.
